headline: Rivian's R2 becomes the company's best-selling vehicle
summary: Rivian said its R2 electric vehicle has become the company's best-selling model, outselling its other EVs for the first time. The company reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.155 billion, up 38 percent, and raised its sales guidance to Wall Street for the second time this year amid strong demand for the R2.
